--auto-skip-seconds.Name: --auto-skip-seconds
--auto-skip-seconds.description: Automatically skip to next entry if nothing happens for a specified number of seconds

--bloom-intensity.Name: --bloom-intensity
--bloom-intensity.description: Adjust the intensity of the bloom

--caption-offset.Name: --caption-offset
--caption-offset.description: Caption horizontal offset (0 to centre captions)

--default-user-image.Name: --default-user-image
--default-user-image.description: Path of .jpg to use as the default user image

--dir-name-depth.Name: --dir-name-depth
--dir-name-depth.description: Draw names of directories down to a specific depth in the tree

--dir-name-position.Name: --dir-name-position
--dir-name-position.description: Position along edge of the directory name (between 0.1 and 1.0, default is 0.5)

--file-extension-fallback.Name: --file-extension-fallback
--file-extension-fallback.description: Use filename as extension if the extension is missing or empty

--file-filter.Name: --file-filter
--file-filter.description: Filter out file paths matching the specified regular expression

--file-idle-time.Name: --file-idle-time
--file-idle-time.description: Time in seconds files remain idle before they are removed or 0 for no limit

--file-idle-time-at-end.Name: --file-idle-time-at-end
--file-idle-time-at-end.description: Time in seconds files remain idle at the end before they are removed

--file-show-filter.Name: --file-show-filter
--file-show-filter.description: Show only file paths matching the specified regular expression

--filename-time.Name: --filename-time
--filename-time.description: Duration to keep filenames on screen (>= 2.0)

--fixed-user-size.Name: --fixed-user-size
--fixed-user-size.description: Forces the size of the user image to remain fixed throughout

--follow-user.Name: --follow-user
--follow-user.description: Have the camera automatically follow a particular user

--font-colour.Name: --font-colour
--font-colour.description: Font colour used by the date and title in hex

--font-file.Name: --font-file
--font-file.description: Specify the font. Should work with most font file formats supported by FreeType, such as TTF and OTF, among others

--font-scale.Name: --font-scale
--font-scale.description: Scale the size of all fonts

--font-size.Name: --font-size
--font-size.description: Font size used by the date and title

--git-branch.Name: --git-branch
--git-branch.description: Get the git log of a branch other than the current one

--hash-seed.Name: --hash-seed
--hash-seed.description: Change the seed of hash function

--hide.Name: --hide
--hide.description: Hide one or more display elements from the list below: bloom - bloom effect date - current date dirnames - names of directories files - file icons filenames - names of files mouse - mouse cursor progress - progress bar widget root - root directory of the tree tree - animated tree structure users - user avatars usernames - names of users

--high-dpi.Name: --high-dpi
--high-dpi.description: Request a high DPI display when creating the window. On some platforms such as MacOS, the window resolution is specified in points instead of pixels. The --high-dpi flag may be required to access some higher resolutions. E.g. requesting a high DPI 800x600 window may produce a window that is 1600x1200 pixels

--highlight-colour.Name: --highlight-colour
--highlight-colour.description: Font colour for highlighted users in hex

--highlight-dirs.Name: --highlight-dirs
--highlight-dirs.description: Highlight the names of all directories

--highlight-user.Name: --highlight-user
--highlight-user.description: Highlight the names of a particular user

--highlight-users.Name: --highlight-users
--highlight-users.description: Highlight the names of all users

--log-command.Name: --log-command
--log-command.description: Show the log command used by gource (git,svn,hg,bzr,cvs2cl)

--log-format.Name: --log-format
--log-format.description: Specify format of the log being read (git,svn,hg,bzr,cvs2cl,custom). Required when reading from STDIN

--logo.Name: --logo
--logo.description: Logo to display in the foreground

--loop.Name: --loop
--loop.description: Loop back to the start of the log when the end is reached

--max-file-lag.Name: --max-file-lag
--max-file-lag.description: Max time files of a commit can take to appear. Use -1 for no limit

--max-files.Name: --max-files
--max-files.description: Set the maximum number of files or 0 for no limit. Excess files will be discarded

--max-user-speed.Name: --max-user-speed
--max-user-speed.description: Max speed users can travel per second

--no-time-travel.Name: --no-time-travel
--no-time-travel.description: Use the time of the last commit if the time of a commit is in the past

--output-custom-log.Name: --output-custom-log
--output-custom-log.description: Output a custom format log file ('-' for STDOUT)

--output-ppm-stream.Name: --output-ppm-stream
--output-ppm-stream.description: Output a PPM image stream to a file ('-' for STDOUT). This will automatically hide the progress bar initially and enable 'stop-at-end' unless other behaviour is specified

--path.Name: --path
--path.description: Either a supported version control directory, a pre-generated log file (see log commands or the custom log format), a Gource conf file or '-' to read STDIN

--save-config.Name: --save-config
--save-config.description: Save a config file with the current options

--screen.Name: --screen
--screen.description: Set the number of the screen to display on

--seconds-per-day.Name: --seconds-per-day
--seconds-per-day.description: Speed of simulation in seconds per day

--selection-colour.Name: --selection-colour
--selection-colour.description: Font colour for selected users and files

--start-date.Name: --start-date
--start-date.description: Start with the first entry after the supplied date and optional time. If a time zone offset isn't specified the local time zone is used. Example accepted formats: 'YYYY-MM-DD', 'YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm', 'YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss +tz'

--start-position.Name: --start-position
--start-position.description: Begin at some position in the log (between 0.0 and 1.0 or 'random')

--stop-at-end.Name: --stop-at-end
--stop-at-end.description: Stop (exit) at the end of the log / stream

--stop-at-time.Name: --stop-at-time
--stop-at-time.description: Stop (exit) after a specified number of seconds

--stop-date.Name: --stop-date
--stop-date.description: Stop at the last entry prior to the supplied date and optional time. Uses the same format as --start-date

--stop-position.Name: --stop-position
--stop-position.description: Stop (exit) at some position in the log (does not work with STDIN)

--transparent.Name: --transparent
--transparent.description: Make the background transparent. Only really useful for screenshots

--user-filter.Name: --user-filter
--user-filter.description: Filter usernames matching the specified regular expression

--user-friction.Name: --user-friction
--user-friction.description: Time users take to come to a halt

--user-image-dir.Name: --user-image-dir
--user-image-dir.description: Directory containing .jpg or .png images of users (eg 'Full Name.png') to use as avatars

--user-show-filter.Name: --user-show-filter
--user-show-filter.description: Show only usernames matching the specified regular expression

--viewport.Name: --viewport
--viewport.description: Set the viewport size. If -f is also supplied, will attempt to set the video mode to this also. Add `!` to make the window non-resizable

--window-position.Name: --window-position
--window-position.description: Initial window position on your desktop which may be made up of multiple monitors. This will override the screen setting so don't specify both

-a.Name: -a
-a.description: Automatically skip to next entry if nothing happens for a specified number of seconds

-i.Name: -i
-i.description: Time in seconds files remain idle before they are removed or 0 for no limit

-o.Name: -o
-o.description: Output a PPM image stream to a file ('-' for STDOUT). This will automatically hide the progress bar initially and enable 'stop-at-end' unless other behaviour is specified

-p.Name: -p
-p.description: Begin at some position in the log (between 0.0 and 1.0 or 'random')

-s.Name: -s
-s.description: Speed of simulation in seconds per day

-t.Name: -t
-t.description: Stop (exit) after a specified number of seconds
